title: clickcast AI-agent bug report
description: Machine-fillable bug-report payload for downstream AI agents. Emitted by `clickcast report-bug --json` and maps 1:1 to `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ai-agent-report.yml` so a filled report renders as a well-formed GitHub issue with no back-and-forth.

schema_version.description: Bumps on breaking changes to this file.

clickcast_version.description: PEP 440 version of the clickcast package that produced the sidecar.

playwright_version.description: Playwright version at capture time. Optional — populated when known.

command_or_api_call.description: The exact command or Python entry point that triggered the failure.

expected.description: One sentence describing the expected outcome.

actual.description: One sentence describing the observed outcome.

kind.description: How to reproduce: a CLI invocation, a scenario YAML, or a Python snippet.

sidecar_excerpt.description: Redaction-friendly subset of the original sidecar (failed step, page_state, warnings, errors). Free-form on purpose — this is what the maintainer inspects first.

environment_note.description: Anything unusual about the environment: proxy, TLS interception, custom DNS, air-gapped, etc.

redacted.description: True when URLs / selectors / visible text were sanitized by `clickcast report-bug --redact` (the default).
